legend.twLive.dengue.area: Release area (local case cluster, past 2 weeks)
legend.twLive.dengue.empty: No local clusters in the past two weeks (data date {date})
legend.twLive.dengue.note: Updated daily by Taiwan CDC. Areas are small release zones within villages, not case addresses.
legend.twLive.nav.shapeArea: Area = notice zone (circles and sectors derived from center and radius)
legend.twLive.nav.shapeLine: Dashed line = route or cable corridor
legend.twLive.nav.permanentNote: Permanent notices are hidden by default: most are old notices never withdrawn. Turn them on in settings if needed.
legend.twLive.nav.count: {count} notices in effect (repeat notices for the same area are drawn as one shape); {unlocated} without coordinates are not mapped
legend.twLive.nav.note: Updated hourly by the Maritime and Port Bureau; only notices in effect are drawn. Can be overlaid with AIS vessels.
legend.twLive.tideLevel.2: Tide / storm surge / high wave warning (pulsing)
legend.twLive.tide.note: Updated hourly by CWA; status covers the past 8 hours. Points sit at CWA marine stations, so overlay the CWA marine observation layer for readings.
legend.twLive.dengue.emptyNotice: Dengue clusters: no local clusters in the past two weeks (data date {date})
